purpose: Recreate a bounded, immutable development substrate through update 700 on the historical 3000-update learning-rate trajectory and measure the complete fixed retention trajectory without selecting or promoting a checkpoint.

repository_identity.issue_blocker: The three development entrypoints are untracked. Before authority is issued, one reviewed commit must contain the exact bytes bound below; the authority must name that commit.

attempt.reservation_mechanism: S0_pack exclusively creates the previously absent pack root, including its parents, before loading either bound H6 index. That fresh directory is the attempt reservation; current source emits no separate reservation receipt.

runtime.note: The time values are hard authorization ceilings, not throughput estimates. Exceeding either ceiling is a terminal consumed failure.

source_closure_contract.runtime_self_check: S0 records and revalidates the five-file pack/H6 closure; S1 records and revalidates its fifteen-file training closure; S2/S3 record and revalidate the sixteen-file union including the retention entrypoint.

rgb_root.allowed_open_rule: Only regular non-symlink RGB leaves named by positions 0 through 3 of either bound H6 index may be opened.

runtime_inputs.place_rgb_rule: Retention may open only regular non-symlink RGB leaves selected by the bound place manifest and checkpoint-selection index.

output_roots.reservation_effect: S0_pack exclusively creates attempt_root and pack_root before opening either H6 index. Training and retention roots remain absent until their owning phase.

preconditions: attempt root, pack root, training root, and retention root are absent
every source binding and the interpreter identity match without opening a runtime input
no forbidden RGB leaf has been opened
phases.runtime_validation_order: The packer first creates the fresh pack root, thereby reserving the attempt, and only then opens and validates the bound H6 indexes and their allowed RGB leaves.
phases.success_condition: manifest schema dev_h6_temporal_pack_v3 validates both roles, the complete five-file pack/H6 source closure, all declared artifact hashes, all ordered source identities, and zero sampled decode deviation

phases.runtime_validation_order: After S0 has reserved the attempt and validated the pack, S1 validates the pack artifacts and exact predecessor checkpoint before loading them.
phases.success_condition: final trace schema dev_temporal_jepa_scaled_v4 is COMPLETE and binds requested/resolved device cuda:0 with HIP visibility selector 1, the exact pack, predecessor, complete fifteen-file training source closure, configuration, eight immutable snapshots, and eight immutable measurement records

phases.runtime_validation_order: After S0 reservation and S1 completion, S2 validates the two place indexes and their manifest-selected regular RGB leaves while opening the frozen spatial runtime.
phases.success_condition: The immutable receipt has schema dev_temporal_retention_composability_v4, status COMPLETE, citable false, requested/resolved device cuda:0 with HIP visibility selector 1, the exact sixteen-file source closure, migrated-predecessor identity, bound H6/place runtime audits, exactly 2,048 successful H6 current-RGB opens and 960 place RGB tensors, and structural_composability.status SKIPPED_BY_REQUEST.

phases.expansion_rule: For each ordered update U, resolve CHECKPOINT_PATH and CHECKPOINT_SHA256 from the same-attempt final_trace record whose update equals U; independently re-hash that regular non-symlink checkpoint; then execute exactly the argv template below with U rendered as six decimal digits in both paths.
phases.per_receipt_success_condition: Each immutable receipt has schema dev_temporal_retention_composability_v4, status COMPLETE, citable false, requested/resolved device cuda:0 with HIP visibility selector 1, the exact sixteen-file source closure, the exact same-attempt snapshot path/update/byte/SHA identity resolved for U, bound H6/place runtime audits, exactly 2,048 successful H6 current-RGB opens and 960 place RGB tensors, and structural_composability.status SKIPPED_BY_REQUEST.
phases.integrity_gate: The u0 retention metrics must equal the matched predecessor-baseline metrics to absolute tolerance 1e-7 for every shared finite scalar; otherwise the tranche terminates as a consumed protocol failure.

receipt_and_supervision_limit.machine_receipts_implemented: pack manifest, training measurements/final trace, and nine retention JSON reports only
receipt_and_supervision_limit.authority_issue_requirement: The issuing authority must bind external process supervision for the two time ceilings and define the terminal review record; this manifest does not pretend those mechanisms exist in current source.

derived_read_policy.scope: Only S3 may read S1 snapshots, only from this attempt, only at the eight ordered updates, and only when path, update, byte count, and SHA-256 agree with S1 final_trace and an independent re-hash.

interpretation_limits: This tranche measures a trajectory; it does not establish a known-good or physically requalified substrate.
Persistence alone cannot select a checkpoint.
The current retention entrypoint does not perform the component-swap decomposition needed to attribute spatial-control change.
Any checkpoint selection and every counterfactual read, render, training, or evaluation require a separately reviewed decision and authority.

forbidden_categories: RGB positions 4, 5, or 6 from either H6 index
legacy development packs, mutable latest checkpoints, or historical July 31 outputs
counterfactual JSONL, counterfactual RGB, physics replay, rendering, or generation
navigation, G2-G8, qualification, probability calibration, promotion, production, or deployment
resume, retry, overwrite, cleanup, output-root reuse, or network access
requirements_before_authority_issue: verify all output roots are absent
bind an authorizer and issue timestamp
confirm the exact GPU selector and hard time ceilings
